prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In & Keep Your Desktop Companion", "Sign in to securely back up your pet. Using a different login method may create a blank account.", "Warning: Re-signing in with a new email resets your active pet."]
1: []
2: ["Choose Your Companion Journey"]
3: ["Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Learn how to summon, interact, and manage your pet on your desktop screen.", "Press Alt+P to hide or show your pet anytime.", "Right-click pet for interactions and voice controls."]
4: ["Initializing Desktop Pet Engine", "Setting up desktop overlay and rendering companion graphics...", "Verifying screen overlay permission..."]
5: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Confirm your pet details and start companion initialization."]
6: ["Your pet is rendering in the background. This typically takes less than 2 minutes.", "Estimated completion time remaining"]
7: ["Welcome Back to Your Desktop Companion", "Please sign in with your original credentials to restore your existing pet setup.", "Need help finding your existing pet account? Use your primary email address."]
8: ["Select Your Pet Experience", "Choose between Interactive Desktop Mascot or Chill Companion mode."]
9: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Double-click your desktop pet anytime to open fast control settings.", "Tip: Right-click pet to hide or snooze"]
